description: Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Mujeres rurales de la C.A. de Euskadi por aspectos a mejorar del trans; Indicadores municipales de sostenibilidad: Conectividad del municipio ; Personas de 16 y más años de la C.A. de Euskadi que usan transporte pú; Precio medio por metro cuadrado construido de las compraventas de vivi. Formats seen: MS-EXCEL, CSV, SHEET, API, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
